Definition: Eljakim, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eliakim = "God raises" or "God sets up"; 1) the son of Hilkiah, master of Hezekiah's household; 2) Josiah's son, enthroned by Pharaoh; 3) a priest who assisted Nehemiah
